name: iam:CreatePolicyVersion
description: Create a new version of an attached IAM policy with administrative permissions and set it as the default version, effectively granting the caller full admin access
author: Seth Art

required.description: Policy ARN must be attached to the actor; for self-escalation on a role, must have permission on own role's policy

additional.description: Required when starting as a user to assume the target role

admin: Policy must already be attached to the actor's role
If starting as a user, must be able to assume the target role
lateral: Policy must already be attached to the actor's role
If starting as a user, must be able to assume the target role

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: ARN of the IAM policy to create a new version of (must be attached to caller)

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the role to escalate (auto-detected from caller if caller is a role; required when caller is a user)

options.name: POLICY_DOCUMENT
options.description: Custom policy document JSON (defaults to full admin *:*)

options.name: VERIFY
options.description: Verify escalation by calling iam:ListUsers after (true/false)

options.name: AUTO_SWITCH
options.description: Automatically switch to new identity after assuming role (true/false)
